Omakase · A menu in motion

Trust is the first ingredient.

An evening shaped course by course, guided by season, temperature, texture, and the quiet confidence of the chef.

Explore ↓

Omakase

A progression, never a script.

Omakase means placing the evening in the chef’s hands. The experience at JIN moves through freshness, warmth, depth, and clarity, with every course arriving at precisely its moment.

The sequence below is illustrative; the final menu will follow the best ingredients available.

The opening

A bright, delicate first course that resets the palate and establishes the season.

From the sea

Sashimi and composed bites chosen for texture, temperature, and natural sweetness.

At the counter

Nigiri formed one piece at a time, seasoned and served at the exact moment it is ready.

The warm course

A pause of gentle heat and deeper aroma before the final movement of the menu.

The finish

A clean, restrained dessert that closes the evening without breaking its rhythm.

The pairing

Sake and tea selected to echo the menu’s changes in weight, texture, and temperature.

No two evenings need to feel identical.

What stays constant is attention: to the ingredient, the room, and the guest.

Season as a guide.

The menu responds to what is at its best. Fatty tuna may arrive with a delicate brush of nikiri; silver fish may be sharpened with acidity; uni may appear warm, cool, or entirely unadorned.

Every decision has a reason.

Temperature, pressure, seasoning, and timing are adjusted piece by piece. That precision is what makes the experience feel effortless.
